verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for an open-source library with an optional hosted console, so the axis applies. However, no evidence item mentions telemetry, usage tracking, or any opt-out switch. Self-hosting Conductor or running the library on your own Postgres is an adjacent deployment choice, not a documented telemetry opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
